graph_id.description: Graph handle from an earlier result. Omit for the most recent.

task_key.description: A task key: a slug from the title, e.g. "write-tests". "T3" and bare numbers are refused.

priority.description: Higher sorts first in the ready queue. Default 0.

edges.description: { from, to } reads "from depends on to": to must be done first. Cycles and self-edges are refused; duplicates ignored.

detail.description: Be generous: retrievable via read(what=task) and the graph resource, but left out of the receipts every other call returns, so length costs nothing per call.
